items.title: What a day at the McClaren Medical Shelter!  If you've driven by lately, you've seen her: a beautiful new sculpture — a...
items.description: What a day at the McClaren Medical Shelter! If you've driven by lately, you've seen her: a beautiful new sculpture — a great ring made of hundreds of hands — now standing proudly in front of this historic building, alongside the brand-new state historical marker telling its remarkable story. From 1949 to 1954, this little brick building was a place of extraordinary care. Black doctors and nurses, shut out of Greenville's hospitals, treated over 1,000 patients and delivered 211 babies right here.
